resolution_notes: Disputed free_tier_limits and rate_limits both fail against current official docs. Free tier is credit-based ($20 on signup ≈2,800 searches, plus $10/month recurring; no card)—not “unknown” and not a flat 1,000 searches. Rate limits are published at exa.ai/docs/reference/rate-limits (defaults: /search 10 QPS, /contents 100 QPS, /answer 10 QPS; enterprise for higher), so “not published” is wrong. Verifier A was directionally right; Verifier B was wrong on both. All other fields keep the original.
free_tier_limits: $20 free credits on signup (~2,800 searches) + $10 free credits/month; no payment method required
rate_limits: Default: /search 10 QPS, /contents 100 QPS, /answer 10 QPS; higher via Enterprise (exa.ai/docs/reference/rate-limits)
